feat:ability-improvement: • Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
feat:actor:
• Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• You gain expertise in Deception and Performance.
• If not already proficient, the character also gains proficiency in the chosen skills.
feat:alert: • You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised.
feat:athlete:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement.
• Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.
feat:charger:
• Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
• Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
• Shove distance depends on your Strength and the target's weight.
• Charger: Weapon attack uses an Action and Bonus Action, moves up to 9 m (30 ft), and makes a melee attack with +5 damage.
• This counts as a single weapon attack, and benefits from Extra Attack.
feat:crossbow-expert:
• When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the attack rolls do not have Disadvantage.
• Your Piercing Shot also inflicts Gaping Wounds for twice as long.
feat:defensive-duellist:
• When you are attacked with a melee attack while wielding a Finesse weapon you are proficient in, you can use a Reaction to increase your Armour Class by your proficiency bonus, possibly causing the attack to miss. Requires Dexterity to be at least 13.
• The weapon equipped in the main hand is required to have Finesse.
feat:dual-wielder:
• You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light.
• You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.
• You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.
• This feat allows a creature to dual-wield weapons that are not Light, provided they are not Two-Handed. However, it does not grant the Two-Weapon Fighting Style; without this Style, the wielder still does not add their Ability Modifier to off-hand melee damage rolls with any weapon.
• Simple melee weapons: Javelins, Maces, Quarterstaves, and Spears
• Martial melee weapons: Battleaxes, Flails, Longswords, Morningstars, Rapiers, Tridents, War Picks, and Warhammers
feat:dungeon-delver:
• You gain Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving Throws made to avoid or resist traps.
• You gain resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
feat:durable:
• Your Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Regain full hit points every time you take a short rest.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• In Wild Shape form,[1]
• Bug: The ability score increase applies.
• The full HP on a short rest applies.
• The HP increase does not apply.
feat:elemental-adept:
• Your spells and attacks ignore resistance to a damage type of your choice. In addition, when you deal that type of damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
• Damage resistance options are one of the following:
• Elemental Adept: Acid
• Elemental Adept: Cold
• Elemental Adept: Lightning
• Elemental Adept: Fire
• Elemental Adept: Thunder
• "You cannot roll a 1" means that whenever a 1 is rolled on a damage die, it is treated as a 2 instead.
feat:great-weapon-master:
• When an attack with a melee weapon lands a Critical Hit or kills a creature, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn.
• When attacking with a Two-Handed or Versatile melee weapon (in both hands) that you are Proficient with, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.
• All In is a toggleable passive ability.
feat:heavily-armoured:
• Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Heavy armour.
• Requires Medium armour Proficiency.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:heavy-armour-master:
• Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour.
• Requires Heavy armour Proficiency.
• Bug: All sources of ⁠Slashing, ⁠Bludgeoning, and ⁠Piercing damage, magical or not, are reduced. Other sources, such as elemental damage, are not affected.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:lightly-armoured:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Light armour.
feat:lucky:
• You gain 3 Luck Points that recharge after a Long Rest.
• You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next Ability Check.
• You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll or Saving Throw, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Roll.
feat:mage-slayer:
• When a creature casts a Spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.
• You can use a Reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster if it casts a spell within 1.5m / 5ft of you.
• Enemies you hit have Disadvantage when making Saving Throws to maintain their Concentration.
feat:magic-initiate-bard: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Bard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
feat:magic-initiate-cleric:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
• Bug: While wearing medium armour, the bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
• The AC bonus increase is not listed in-game, and can also be gained by taking the Medium Armour Master feat.
feat:magic-initiate-druid: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
feat:magic-initiate-sorcerer:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Sorcerer spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
• Bug: If Shield is provided by this feat, then it uses spell slots like an ordinary spell without a once-per-long-rest restriction. This means that it cannot be used at all by a character with no spell slots.
feat:magic-initiate-warlock: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Warlock spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
feat:magic-initiate-wizard:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Intelligence.
• Bug: If Shield is provided by this feat, then it uses spell slots like an ordinary spell without a once-per-long-rest restriction. This means that it cannot be used at all by a character with no spell slots.
feat:martial-adept: • Learn two Manoeuvres from the Battle Master archetype and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest.
feat:medium-armour-master:
• When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
• Requires Medium armour Proficiency.
feat:mobile:
• Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft).
• When you use the Dash action, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.
• If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke an Opportunity Attack from that target.
feat:moderately-armoured:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Medium armour and Shields.
feat:performer:
• Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Musical Instrument Proficiency.
feat:polearm-master:
• When attacking with a Glaive, Halberd, Pike, Quarterstaff, or Spear, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.
• You can also make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.
• The damage modifier of this attack uses Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher, even if the weapon does not have the finesse property. This is still true when using Shillelagh.
• Polearm Master works with Pikes even though this is not stated in-game. (see [2])
• If chosen as a feat during level-up, there is no indication of this later under "Notable Features" on the character sheet. Furthermore, the passives Polearm Master: Bonus Attack and Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack are situational actions and are only visible on the hotbar in combat.
feat:resilient:
• You increase an Ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency in that ability's Saving Throws.
• The available passive features are:
• Resilient: Strength
• Resilient: Dexterity
• Resilient: Constitution
• Resilient: Intelligence
• Resilient: Wisdom
• Resilient: Charisma
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:ritual-caster:
• You learn two Ritual spells of your choice.
• The available spells are:
• Speak with Dead
• Find Familiar
• Longstrider
• Enhance Leap
• Disguise Self
• Speak with Animals
• The version of Find Familiar granted by this feat has a separate once per short rest cooldown not shared with the spellbook version. Knowing both versions of Find Familiar will allow a caster to summon multiple familiars per short rest, though they are still limited to one familiar active at a time.
feat:savage-attacker: • When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
feat:sentinel:
• When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.
• When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.
• You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
feat:sharpshooter:
• Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.
• Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack Roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.
• All In is a toggleable passive ability.
feat:shield-master:
• Gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throw when wielding a Shield.
• If a Spell forces you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage.
• - On a failed save, you only take half damage.
• - On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would.
• Bug: This feat does not reduce the damage taken on a failed save.
• Unlike the DnD counterpart, this feat doesn't take shield AC into account and instead only offers a flat bonus to Dexterity Saving Throw.
feat:skilled: • You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.
feat:spell-sniper:
• You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
• The available cantrips are:
• Bone Chill
• Eldritch Blast
• Fire Bolt
• Ray of Frost
• Shocking Grasp
• Thorn Whip
• These cantrips use the character's Spellcasting Ability. For example, if a Cleric chooses Eldritch Blast with this feat, they use their Wisdom modifier and not their Charisma modifier.
• All available cantrips are Spell Attacks and use Attack Roll
feat:tavern-brawler:
• Your Strength or Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your strength modifier is added twice to the damage and Attack Roll.
• Unarmed attacks that use Dexterity as a modifier still gain the strength modifier as a bonus with this feat and thus don't get the Dexterity modifier applied twice to the attack.
feat:tough: • Hit Point maximum increased by 2 for each level.
feat:war-caster:
• You gain Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a Spell.
• You can also use a Reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.
• This feat does not grant the ability to use Shocking Grasp at will. Unless you know it from another source, you can only use it as an Attack of Opportunity.
• Casting Shocking Grasp as an Attack of Opportunity uses the character's Spellcasting Ability. For example, if a Cleric casts Shocking Grasp with this feat, they use their Wisdom modifier.
feat:weapon-master:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with four Weapon types of your choice.

feature:accursed-spectre: When you or an ally within 18 m (60 ft) slay a creature that is afflicted with Hexblade's Curse, you can raise an Accursed Spectre that will fight alongside you for a short period of time.
feature:acid-breath: Spew forth a line of acid.
feature:action-surge: Immediately gain an extra Action to use this turn.
feature:armour-of-hexes: When a creature you cursed with Hexblade's Curse attacks you, potentially nullify the attack as a reaction. This has a 50% chance of succeeding.
feature:artificers-lore: Add twice your Proficiency Bonus to History checks.
feature:astral-knowledge: Gain Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.
feature:beguiling-defences: You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be Charmed.
feature:bind-hexed-weapon: Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. When you attack with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.
feature:brave: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Frightened.
feature:civil-militia:
You have weapon proficiency with:
• Spears
• Pikes
• Halberds
• Glaives
• Light armour
• Shields
feature:curving-shot: When you miss with any magical ranged attack, use a Bonus Action to attack the next closest target with the same attack.
feature:dark-ones-blessing: Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this gift from your patron grants you Charisma modifier + Warlock level temporary hit points.
feature:dark-ones-own-luck: Call on your patron to change your fate and add a 1d10 to an Ability Check.
feature:darkvision: Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).
feature:deepened-pact: Pleased with your service, your otherworldly patron added new boons to the terms of your pact.
feature:draconic-ancestry-acid: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Acid damage.
feature:draconic-ancestry-cold: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Cold damage.
feature:draconic-ancestry-fire: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Fire damage.
feature:draconic-ancestry-lightning: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Lightning damage.
feature:draconic-ancestry-poison: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Poison damage.
feature:draconic-resilience: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base Armour Class is 13.
feature:drow-weapon-training: You have proficiency with Rapiers, Shortswords, and Hand Crossbows.
feature:duergar-resilience: An affected creature has Advantage on Saving Throws against Illusions and against being Charmed or Paralysed.
feature:dwarven-armour-training: You have Armour Proficiency with Light armour and Medium armour.
feature:dwarven-combat-training: You have Proficiency with Battleaxes, Handaxes, Light Hammers, and Warhammers.
feature:dwarven-resilience: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned and you have Resistance against Poison damage.
feature:dwarven-toughness: You have 1 extra maximum hit points per level.
feature:eldritch-strike: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has Disadvantage on its next Saving Throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
feature:elven-weapon-training: You have Proficiency with Longswords, Shortswords, Longbows, and Shortbows.
feature:entropic-ward:
As a reaction, you can impose Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you.
If the attack misses, you gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll against your attacker for 1 turn.
feature:evasion: Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful Dexterity Saving Throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.
feature:extra-attack: You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.
feature:fast-movement: Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while not wearing Heavy Armour.
feature:fey-ancestry: The Feywild casts a veil over your mind. You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Charmed, and magic can't put you to Sleep.
feature:fey-presence: Charm or Frighten nearby foes with the feywild's beguiling, disturbing magics.
feature:fiendish-resilience: Choose a damage type and become Resistant to it. You can pick a new damage type each Short Rest.
feature:fire-breath-cone: Spew forth a cone of fire.
feature:fire-breath-line: Spew forth a column of fire.
feature:frost-breath: Spew forth a cone of ice.
feature:gnome-cunning: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.
feature:halfling-luck: When you roll a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw, you can reroll the dice and must use the new roll.
feature:hellish-resistance: Your blood protects you from flame, abyssal or otherwise. Gain Resistance to Fire damage, taking only half damage from it.
feature:hex-warrior:
You gain proficiency with Medium armour, Shields, and Martial weapons.
You gain Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.
feature:hexblades-curse:
Curse a target. Your damage rolls against the target gain a bonus equal to your Proficiency bonus. The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking the target is also reduced by 1.
If the target dies, you regain Warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points.
feature:human-versatility: Select an additional Skill to be Proficient in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.
feature:improved-combat-superiority: The size of your Superiority Die increases to a d10
feature:improved-critical-hit: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
feature:improved-extra-attack: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.
feature:indomitable: Whenever you fail a Saving Throw, you can roll again, using the new result instead.
feature:jack-of-all-trades: Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to Ability Checks that you are not Proficient in.
feature:lightning-breath: Spew forth a column of lightning.
feature:magic-arrow: All of your ranged attacks are considered magical to overcome Resistance.
feature:martial-prodigy: A lifetime of relentless training gave you Armour proficiency with Light armour and Medium armour, as well as Proficiency with Shortswords, Longswords, and Greatswords.
feature:misty-escape: Transform into a tiny mist cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.
feature:mortal-reminder: When you land a Critical Hit against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.
feature:naturally-stealthy: Your nimble nature makes you skilled at concealment. You have Advantage on Stealth Checks.
feature:poison-breath: Spew forth a cone of poison.
feature:relentless-endurance: If you reach 0 hit points, you regain 1 Hit Point instead of becoming Downed.
feature:remarkable-athlete-jump: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. Your Jump distance is increased by 3 m (10 ft).
feature:remarkable-athlete-proficiency: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. You can add half of your Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks that you are not Proficient in.
feature:savage-attacks: When you land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.
feature:second-wind: Draw on your stamina to protect yourself. You regain 1d10 + Fighter Level Hit Points.
feature:shortened-stride: Your movement speed is 7.5 m (25 ft).
feature:stone-camouflage: You have Advantage on Stealth checks.
feature:strongheart-resilience: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.
feature:superior-darkvision: Can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).
feature:thought-shield-psychic-reflectio: Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.
feature:thought-shield-psychic-resistanc: An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to Psychic damage.
feature:unarmoured-defence-barbarian: Your body is as resilient as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Constitution Modifier to your Armour Class.
feature:unarmoured-defence-monk: Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your Armour Class.
feature:unarmoured-movement: Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.
feature:war-magic: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a cantrip, you can make a weapon attack using a Bonus Action.
feature:weapon-bond: Ritually bind the weapon in your main hand. The weapon can't be knocked out of your hand, and it automatically returns to you when thrown.
option:arcane-shots:banishing-arrow: Use Abjuration magic to potentially Banish your target to the Feywild.
option:arcane-shots:beguiling-arrow: Use Enchantment magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Charmed.
option:arcane-shots:bursting-arrow: Use Evocation magic to make your arrow explode on impact and deal an additional 2d6 Force damage to targets within 5 m (17 ft).
option:arcane-shots:enfeebling-arrow: Use Necromatic magic to deal an additional 2d6 Necrotic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Feeble.
option:arcane-shots:grasping-arrow: Deal an additional 2d6 Poison damage. Affected entity's movement speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft) and it will take 2d6 Slashing damage when it moves.
option:arcane-shots:piercing-arrow: Use Transmutation magic to attack all those within the line of your shot. Each target must succeed a Saving Throw or be dealt an additional 1d6 Piercing damage.
option:arcane-shots:seeking-arrow:
Use Divination magic to make your arrow seek a target. The arrow deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and possibly applies Faerie Fire.
This arrow always hits its target.
option:arcane-shots:shadow-arrow: Use Illusion magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Blinded.
option:eldritch-invocations:agonising-bl: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma Modifier to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.
option:eldritch-invocations:armour-of-sh: You can cast Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot. Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you are not wearing armour.
option:eldritch-invocations:beast-speech: You can cast Speak with Animals on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:beguiling-in: You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.
option:eldritch-invocations:book-of-anci:
You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Gain Ray of Sickness, Chromatic Orb, and Silence spells.
You can cast them once per Long Rest and they don't expend spell slots
option:eldritch-invocations:devils-sight: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 24 m (80 ft).
option:eldritch-invocations:dreadful-wor: You can cast Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:fiendish-vig: You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:lifedrinker: Attacks made with your melee weapon deal additional necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
option:eldritch-invocations:mask-of-many: You can cast Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:minions-of-c: You can cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:mire-the-min: You can cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:one-with-sha: You learn how to cast One with Shadows.
option:eldritch-invocations:otherworldly: You can cast the Enhance Leap spell without expending a spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:repelling-bl: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.
option:eldritch-invocations:sculptor-of-: You can cast Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:sign-of-ill-: You can cast Bestow Curse with a Warlock Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:thief-of-fiv: Once per Long Rest, you can cast Bane using a Warlock Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:whispers-of-: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a Warlock spell slot.
option:elemental-adept-elements:acid: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:cold: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:fire: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:lightnin: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:thunder: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:fighting-styles:archery: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls you make with ranged Weapons.
option:fighting-styles:defence: You gain a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing armour.
option:fighting-styles:duelling: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon.
option:fighting-styles:great-weapon-figh: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.
option:fighting-styles:protection: When you have a Shield, impose Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within 1.5 m (5 ft). You must be able to see the enemy.
option:fighting-styles:two-weapon-fighti: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.
option:manoeuvres:commanders-strike: Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack.
option:manoeuvres:disarming-attack: Focus your attack on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.
option:manoeuvres:distracting-strike: Distract the target, giving your allies Advantage on their next attack roll against it.
option:manoeuvres:evasive-footwork: Evade attacks; enemies receive Disadvantage on melee attacks against you.
option:manoeuvres:feinting-attack: Use both your action and bonus action on a turn to attack a target with Advantage and bonus damage.
option:manoeuvres:goading-attack: Goad an enemy into attacking only you. It gains Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you.
option:manoeuvres:manoeuvring-attack: Attack an enemy. On a hit, you can use Forced Manoeuvre on an ally, increasing their movement speed.
option:manoeuvres:menacing-attack: Possibly Frighten your target. They'll have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls and be unable to move.
option:manoeuvres:precision-attack: You can spend a Superiority Die to add it to the result to an Attack Roll.
option:manoeuvres:pushing-attack: Spend a superiority die to deal an additional 1d8 Physical damage and possibly push the target back 4.5 m (15 ft).
option:manoeuvres:rally: Expend a superiority die to bolster the resolve of a friendly creature. It gains an additional 8 temporary hit points.
option:manoeuvres:riposte: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional Superiority Die damage.
option:manoeuvres:sweeping-attack: Swing your weapon in a rapid, sweeping arc to attack multiple enemies at once. Roll your superiority die for damage.
option:manoeuvres:trip-attack: A powerful attack that possibly knocks the target Prone.
option:pact-boons:pact-of-the-blade: You can Summon a pact weapon, or Bind the one you are wielding as one, making it magical.
option:pact-boons:pact-of-the-chain: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit.
option:pact-boons:pact-of-the-tome: Your patron grants you a grimoire called "The Book of Shadows", which allows you to cast Guidance, Vicious Mockery, and Thorn Whip.
spell:acid-splash: Throw a bubble of acid that damages each creature it hits.
spell:aid: Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum.
spell:animal-friendship: Convince a beast not to attack you.
spell:animate-dead: Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat.
spell:arcane-gate: Create two linked teleportation portals within range. All creatures, including enemies, may travel between the two portals as a free action.
spell:arcane-lock: Close a door or container with a magical lock. It can no longer be lockpicked or opened with Knock.
spell:armour-of-agathys: Gain 5 temporary hit points and deal 5 Cold damage to any creature that hits you with a melee attack.
spell:bane: Up to 3 creatures receive a -1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
spell:banishing-smite: Possibly Banish your target to another plane of existence.
spell:banishment: Temporarily Banish your target to another plane of existence.
spell:barkskin: Touch a willing creature to toughen its skin and increase its Armour Class up to 16.
spell:beacon-of-hope: Your allies will regain the maximum Hit Points possible when healed. They also gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Death Saving Throws.
spell:bestow-curse:
Curse a creature with your touch. The curse either bestows Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws, Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, lets you deal additional damage to the target, or robs it of its Actions.
The effect of the curse is based on the variant selected and lasts for 10 turns.
spell:blade-barrier: Summons a wall of razor-sharp blades that turns the area into Difficult Terrain and damages anyone foolish enough to come close.
spell:blade-ward: Take only half the damage from Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing attacks.
spell:bless: Bless up to 3 creatures. They gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
spell:blight: Deals 8d8 Necrotic damage to a target. Plants take maximum damage from this spell, and have Disadvantage on the Saving Throw against it.
spell:blinding-smite: Evoke a heavenly flare and possibly Blind your target
spell:blindness: Blind a creature. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage.
spell:blink: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world.
spell:blur: Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.
spell:bone-chill: Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
spell:booming-blade: Strike with your weapon, afflicting your foe with a resonance that hurts them for 1d8 Thunder when they move.
spell:branding-smite: Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.
spell:burning-hands: Each flammable target is hit with 3d6 Fire damage.
spell:bursting-sinew: Explode a corpse, causing it to impale those around it.
spell:call-lightning: Lightning strikes all targets within the area of effect for 3d10 Lightning damage. Then for 10 turns, you can call down lightning again without expending a spell slot.
spell:calm-emotions: Humanoids can't be Charmed, Frightened, or become enraged.
spell:chain-lightning: Strike an enemy with lightning. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other enemies within range.
spell:charm-person: Charm a humanoid to prevent it from attacking you. You gain Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue.
spell:chromatic-orb:
Hurl a sphere of energy.
It deals 3d8 Thunder damage, or 2d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison damage and creates a surface.
spell:circle-of-death: Sculpt a massive sphere of entropic energy around a creature. Devastate the target and all surrounding creatures.
spell:cloud-of-daggers: Conjure a cloud of spinning daggers that attack anyone inside.
spell:cloudkill: Craft a large cloud that inflicts 5d8 Poison damage per turn. You can reposition the cloud every turn.
spell:colour-spray: Blind creatures up to a combined 33 Hit Points.
spell:command: Command a creature to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground or drop its weapon. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw in order to resist the effects.
spell:compelled-duel: Force an enemy to attack only you, giving it Disadvantage against other targets.
spell:cone-of-cold: Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands.
spell:confusion: Confuse a group of creatures, causing them to attack at random, wander around aimlessly, and occasionally skip turns in the stupor.
spell:conjure-barrage: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.
spell:conjure-elemental: Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you.
spell:conjure-minor-elemental: Conjure a minor elemental to fight alongside you.
spell:conjure-woodland-being: Conjure a dryad to fight alongside you. She can use Nature's Step, Entangle enemies, and Summon a wood woad.
spell:contagion:
Poison a target and possibly afflict them with a disease of your choice.
Once infected, the target will roll a Constitution Saving throw each turn. If it accumulates 3 successes, it recovers. If it accumulates 3 failures, it contracts the disease chosen by the spellcaster.
spell:counterspell: Try to stop a spell being cast.
spell:create-or-destroy-water: Choose to call forth rain or destroy a water-based surface.
spell:create-undead: Create a corpse as a heinous mummy that fights by your side.
spell:crown-of-madness:
Instil madness in a humanoid enemy, making them attack the creature closest to them (other than you), even if it's allied.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.
spell:crusaders-mantle: Radiate a holy power that emboldens you and nearby allies. Their weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.
spell:cure-wounds: Heal a creature you can touch.
spell:darkness: Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.
spell:darkvision: Grant a creature the ability to see in the dark out to a range of {12 m (40 ft).
spell:daylight: Enchant an item to shine like the sun or summon a sphere of sunlight that dispels all darkness around it.
spell:death-ward: Protect a creature from death. The next time damage would reduce it to 0 Hit Points, it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left.
spell:detect-thoughts: Focus your mind to read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.
spell:dimension-door: Teleport yourself and up to one adjacent ally to a place you can see. The ally cannot be larger than Medium.
spell:disguise-self: Magically change all aspects of your appearance.
spell:disintegrate: If the target fails a Dexterity Saving Throw, and the spell reduces it to 0 hit points, it disintegrates into a crumbly ash.
spell:dispel-evil-and-good: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.
spell:dissonant-whispers: Frighten a creature: they'll have Disadvantage on Ability checks and Attack rolls and they cannot move.
spell:divine-favour: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Your weapons deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.
spell:dominate-beast: Make a beast fight alongside you. Every time the Beast takes damage, it makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against your domination.
spell:dominate-person: Dominate a nearby humanoid. Allies are unaffected.
spell:drow-magic-faerie-fire: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.
spell:eldritch-blast: Conjure a beam of crackling energy. Deals 1d10 Force damage to a target.
spell:elemental-weapon: Imbue a weapon with elemental power. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 damage of your choice.
spell:elemental-weapon-acid: Imbue a weapon with corrosive might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Acid damage.
spell:elemental-weapon-cold: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Cold damage.
spell:elemental-weapon-fire: Imbue a weapon with fiery might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage.
spell:elemental-weapon-lightning: Imbue a weapon with an electrical might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.
spell:elemental-weapon-thunder: Imbue a weapon with thunderous might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.
spell:enhance-ability: Bestow a magical enchantment upon an ally. They gain Advantage on Ability Checks with a chosen Ability.
spell:enlarge-duergar: Grow in size to become stronger.
spell:enlarge-reduce:
Make a creature larger or smaller. Either option has a duration of 10 turns.
This affects their weapon damage and Strength Checks and Saving throws.
spell:ensnaring-strike: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.
spell:entangle: Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into Difficult Terrain and possibly Entangling creatures within.
spell:enthrall: Reduce a creature's peripheral vision and make it look at you.
spell:evards-black-tentacles: Tentacles sprout from the ground, turning the area into Difficult Terrain, attacking and Smothering creatures within.
spell:expeditious-retreat: Gain Dash immediately and as a bonus action on each of your turns until this spell ends.
spell:eyebite: Your eyes become black corridors walled in teeth, your gaze capable of inflicting dread, sickness, or putting creatures to sleep.
spell:faerie-fire: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.
spell:false-life: Bolster yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life to gain 7 temporary hit points.
spell:fear: Hostile targets drop everything and become Fearful: they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
spell:feather-fall: You and nearby allies gain Immunity to Falling damage.
spell:feign-death: Put an ally in a protective coma. They become Resistant to all damage except Psychic. Disease and poison no longer have any effect.
spell:find-familiar: Summon a familiar, a fey spirit that takes an animal form of your choosing
spell:fire-shield: Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, provide Resistance to Fire or Cold damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.
spell:fireball: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for 8d6 Fire damage.
spell:flame-blade: Conjure a flaming Scimitar in your hand for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire damage. It sheds a bright light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius and a dim light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius.
spell:flame-strike: Make a pillar of divine fire roar down from the heavens like the wrath of affronted angels.
spell:flaming-sphere: Summon a Flaming Sphere that deals 2d6 Fire damage to nearby enemies and objects. It also sheds bright light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius, and dim light for an additional 6 m (20 ft). You can move the sphere.
spell:flesh-to-stone: Atrophy a foe, Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.
spell:fog-cloud: Create a cloud of dense fog to Heavily Obscure and Blind creatures within.
spell:freedom-of-movement: Snap an ally out of any Stun. Difficult Terrain can't slow them down, and they can't be magically Paralysed or Restrained.
spell:friends: Gain Advantage on Charisma Checks against a non-hostile creature.
spell:gaseous-form: Transform yourself or an ally into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.
spell:githyanki-psionics-mage-hand: Create an invisible spectral hand that can manipulate and interact with objects.
spell:globe-of-invulnerability: Create a barrier that makes creatures and objects inside it immune to all damage.
spell:glyph-of-warding: Inscribe a circle of arcane glyphs on the ground. When stepped on by an enemy the selected magical effect will trigger.
spell:goodberry:
Conjure four magical berries for yourself or a companion. Creatures who eat a berry regain 1d4 hit points.
Each berry counts as one Camp Supplies.
The berries appear in the targeted creature's inventory and disappear after a Long Rest.
spell:grant-flight: Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself or an ally.
spell:grasping-vine: Summon a giant vine capable of dragging creatures toward itself.
spell:grease: Cover the ground in flammable grease. It becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within can fall Prone.
spell:greater-invisibility: Turn a creature Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.
spell:greater-restoration: Touch a creature and negate any Charm, Petrification, Stun, or Curse.
spell:guardian-of-faith: Call forth a divine guardian that attacks nearby enemies. Every time it deals damage, the guardian loses an equal amount of Hit Points.
spell:guidance: The target gains +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.
spell:guiding-bolt: The next attack roll against this target has Advantage.
spell:gust-of-wind: Summon a strong wind that clears all clouds. Any creatures caught in the gale who fail a Strength Saving Throw will be pushed back 5 m (17 ft) and be thrown Off Balance.
spell:hail-of-thorns: Shoot a volley of thorns. The thorns deal weapon damage to the target and then explode. The explosion deals an additional 1d10 Piercing damage to the target and surrounding creatures. On miss, the thorns still explode. On save, targets still take half damage from the explosion.
spell:harm: Reduce a target's maximum hit points, but never below 1.
spell:haste: Target yourself or an ally to become Hastened. The creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class, Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, its Movement Speed is doubled, and can take one additional Action per turn.
spell:heal: Heals a target's wounds and remove Blindness and any diseases.
spell:healing-word: Heal a creature you can see.
spell:heat-metal: Cause a metal weapon or armour to glow red-hot and force the wearer to let go or receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
spell:hellish-rebuke: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10 Fire damage.
spell:heroes-feast: You and everyone around can't be Poisoned, Diseased, or Frightened (status group). Everyone's maximum Hit Points increases by 12, and they make Wisdom Saving Throws with Advantage.
spell:heroism: Make yourself or a target immune to Frightened and gain 5 Temporary Hit Points each turn.
spell:hex: Make your attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target and give it Disadvantage on an Ability of your choosing.
spell:hold-monster: Paralyse a creature. It can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always critical hits.
spell:hold-person:
Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always Critical Hits.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.
spell:hunger-of-hadar: Creatures within this black sphere are Blinded and take damage at the end of their turn and the start of their turn.
spell:hunters-mark: Mark a creature as your quarry to deal an additional 1d6 Weapon damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.
spell:hypnotic-pattern: Hypnotise creatures that can see the pattern. They cannot attack you. They cannot move nor act.
spell:ice-knife: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.
spell:ice-storm: Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing Bludgeoning and Cold damage. It also creates an Ice surface that lasts 2 turns.
spell:infernal-legacy-hellish-rebuke: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 3d10 Fire damage.
spell:inflict-wounds: Putrefy a creature with Necrotic energy filling your hands.
spell:insect-plague: Locusts attack everyone within range, make the area Difficult Terrain, and impose Disadvantage on Perception Checks.
spell:invisibility: Touch a creature to turn it Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.
spell:knock: Unlock an object that is held shut by a mundane lock.
spell:legacy-of-avernus-branding-smite: Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.
spell:legacy-of-avernus-searing-smite: Deal an extra 2d6 Fire and set your target on fire: it takes 1d6 Fire every turn.
spell:legacy-of-cania-burning-hands: Each flammable target is hit with 4d6 Fire damage.
spell:legacy-of-cania-flame-blade: Conjure a flaming Scimitar in your hand for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire damage. It sheds a bright light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius and a dim light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius.
spell:lesser-restoration: Cure a creature from Diseased, Poisoned, Paralysis, or Blinded.
spell:light: Infuse an object with an aura of light.
spell:lightning-arrow: After the arrow hits, smaller bolts snake out from the target towards nearby creatures.
spell:lightning-bolt: Call forth a blast of lightning that hits all creatures in the line of the eruption.
spell:longstrider: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).
spell:mage-armour: Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier.
spell:mage-hand: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate and interact with objects.
spell:magic-missile:
Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target.
The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually.
spell:magic-weapon: Infuse a weapon with arcane energy. The weapon becomes magical, receiving a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls.
spell:mass-cure-wounds: Unleash a soothing hum of energy that heals you and nearby allies.
spell:melfs-acid-arrow:
Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals 4d4 Acid damage immediately and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.
If the spell misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage at the end of its next turn.
spell:minor-illusion: Create an illusion that compels nearby creatures to investigate.
spell:mirror-image: Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your Armour Class by 3.
spell:misty-step: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.
spell:moonbeam: Call down a beam of light that damages any creatures that enters the beam or starts its turn in the light. You can use an Action to move the beam 18 m (60 ft).
spell:otilukes-freezing-sphere: Create a ball of churning ice that can be launched instantly to generate a frosty explosion or stored for later use.
spell:otilukes-resilient-sphere: Enclose a target in a sphere of shimmering force, reducing its movement speed by half, and blocking all incoming and spell effects.
spell:ottos-irresistible-dance: Cause a creature to start dancing, making it unable to take Actions or Move. Its attackers have Advantage on Attack rolls.
spell:pass-without-trace: Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.
spell:phantasmal-force: Deal damage to a creature each turn. At the start of its turn, it takes Psychic damage. Each subsequent time it takes damage, the damage type of Phantasmal Force changes to match that damage type.
spell:phantasmal-killer: Haunt a creature with illusions of its greatest fears. It takes 4d10 Psychic Damage per turn, cannot move, has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls
spell:planar-ally: Beseech one of these otherworldly entities for aid. Summon either an Elemental, Celestial, or Fiend to fight for you.
spell:planar-binding: Target an otherworldly creature and attach its consciousness to your own. It will follow and fight for you as an ally.
spell:plant-growth: Make weeds burst from the ground and smother the area. Creatures moving through the weeds have their Movement Speed quartered.
spell:poison-spray: Project a puff of noxious gas, dealing 1d12 Poison to a target.
spell:polymorph: Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.
spell:prayer-of-healing: Heal all allies you can see within range.
spell:produce-flame: A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8 Fire damage when thrown.
spell:protection-from-energy: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.
spell:protection-from-evil-and-good: Protect an ally against the attacks and powers of Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.
spell:protection-from-poison: Touch a creature to neutralise all poisons affecting it, and grant it protection against poisonous influences.
spell:ray-of-enfeeblement: Weaken a foe: they deal half damage with weapon attacks using Strength.
spell:ray-of-frost: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).
spell:remove-curse: Touch a creature or object to remove all Curses and Hexes affecting it.
spell:resistance: Make a target more resistant to spell effects and conditions: it receives a +1d4 bonus to Saving Throws.
spell:revivify: Revive a companion. They return to life with 1 hit point.
spell:sacred-flame: Engulf a target in a flame-like radiance.
spell:sanctuary: You or an ally cannot be targeted until you attack or harm a creature. You can still take damage from area spells.
spell:scorching-ray: Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire damage.
spell:searing-smite: Your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. It deals, on top of weapon damage, an extra 1d6 Fire damage and marks the target with Searing Smite.
spell:see-invisibility: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.
spell:seeming: Disguise up to 4 members of your adventuring party.
spell:shadow-blade: Weave a shadowy shortsword in your hand that deals 2d8 Psychic damage.
spell:shatter: Damages all nearby creatures and objects.
spell:shield: When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile. These effects last until the start of your next turn.
spell:shield-of-faith: Surround a creature with a shimmering field of magic that increases its Armour Class by 2.
spell:shillelagh:
Quarterstaff or Club Required.
Your staff or club becomes magical: it deals 1d8 + Spellcasting modifier Bludgeoning damage, and uses your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls.
spell:shocking-grasp: The target cannot use Reactions. This spell has Advantage on creatures with metal Armour.
spell:silence: Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and Immune to Thunder damage.
spell:sleep: Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points.
spell:sleet-storm:
Call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an Ice surface, and forces spellcasters to succeed at a Concentration Saving Throw in order to maintain Concentration.
Ice is a surface that is considered Difficult Terrain. Creatures moving through it have their Movement Speed halved, and will fall Prone on a failed Dexterity Saving Throw.
spell:slow: Alter time around up to 6 enemies to Slow them. They won't get far, they can't do much, and they're easier to hit.
spell:speak-with-animals: Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts.
spell:speak-with-dead: Grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.
spell:spike-growth:
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 1.5 m (5 ft) it moves.
The spikes are Difficult Terrain, halving a creature's Movement Speed.
spell:spirit-guardians: Call forth spirits to protect you.
spell:spiritual-weapon: Summon a floating, spectral weapon that attacks your enemies alongside you.
spell:staggering-smite: Possibly Stagger your target. It can't take reactions and is more likely to miss.
spell:stinking-cloud: Create a cloud of gas so nauseating it prevents creatures from taking actions.
spell:stoneskin: Turn a creature's flesh hard as stone. It takes only half the damage of all non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
spell:sunbeam: A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path.
spell:tashas-hideous-laughter: Leave a creature Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up.
spell:telekinesis: Throw a creature or object up to 18 m (60 ft) with a thought. Once per turn, you can use Telekinesis again without expending a Spell Slot.
spell:thaumaturgy: Gain Advantage on Intimidation and Performance Checks.
spell:thorn-whip: Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you.
spell:thunderous-smite: Your melee weapon rings with thunder as you strike, pushing your target 3 m (10 ft) away and possibly knocking them Prone.
spell:thunderwave: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage.
spell:toll-the-dead: Ring the bell of impending doom. If the target is at full health, you deal 1d8 Necrotic damage instead.
spell:true-strike: Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll.
spell:vampiric-touch: Touch an enemy to siphon their life force and regain half as many Hit Points.
spell:vicious-mockery: Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll.
spell:wall-of-fire: Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area.
spell:wall-of-ice: Raise a wall of solid ice that deals 10d6 Cold damage to anyone standing in its way.
spell:wall-of-stone:
Raise a wall of non-magical, solid stone.
The wall can be created between any two points within range as long as there is a clear path between them. It is made up of Stone Pillars with 30 HP each, immune to Psychic and vulnerable to Force and Thunder damage. Pillars block movement and line of sight.
spell:wall-of-thorns: Create a wall of pliable, twisting thorns surrounded by Entangling vines.
spell:warden-of-vitality: While this aura lasts, you can cast Restore Vitality as a Bonus Action to heal yourself or nearby allies by 2d6 hit points.
spell:warding-bond: Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their Armour Class and Saving Throws.
spell:web:
Cover an area in thick, flammable webbing that can Enweb creatures within.
An ally can use its Help action to try and tear away the webs.
spell:wind-walk: Transform yourself and all nearby party members into tiny clouds of mist to avoid attacks.
spell:witch-bolt: Link yourself to a target with a bolt of lightning. Deal an additional 1d12 Lightning damage each turn by activating it.
spell:wrathful-smite: Your weapon absorbs your wrath as you strike, possibly Frightening your target.
